mapper.select: SELECT pl.log_id AS logId, pl.shop_id AS shopId, s.shop_name AS shopName, pl.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, u.phone AS phone, pl.action_type AS actionType, pl.pre_base_points AS preBasePoints, pl.pre_bonus_points AS preBonusPoints, pl.change_base AS changeBase, pl.change_bonus AS changeBonus, pl.after_base_points AS afterBasePoints, pl.after_bonus_points AS afterBonusPoints, pl.status AS status, pl.remark AS remark, pl.coupon_id AS couponId, ct.coupon_name AS couponName, ct.type AS couponType, pl.create_time AS createTime, pl.consume_time AS consumeTime, (ABS(IFNULL(pl.change_base, 0)) + ABS(IFNULL(pl.change_bonus, 0))) AS consumePoints FROM mobi_points_log pl INNER JOIN mobi_user u ON u.user_id = pl.user_id INNER JOIN mobi_shop s ON s.id = pl.shop_id LEFT JOIN mobi_user_coupons uc ON uc.user_coupon_id = pl.coupon_id LEFT JOIN mobi_coupon_template ct ON ct.template_id = COALESCE(uc.template_id, pl.coupon_id) WHERE pl.log_id = #{logId} LIMIT 1
